hardware: Original mobile cable with owner-installed 2 A firmware, external 5 V, right-eye camera. No cable or headset flash in this investigation.

initial_black.right_lens: black while external screenshot showed stereo cubes

black_state_tests: Warm foreground relaunch and full cold restart of both processes remained black.
External display power-off verified OFF, then reset to ON; still black. Logical disable and enable also did not restore the image.
Repeated SWITCHSCREEN=1, then a separately acknowledged SWITCHSCREEN=0/1 cycle; still black.
Restored the actual brightness setting 4 with a two-byte HID write; still black.
USB port reset detached and re-added audio and HID at the same bus addresses without removing logical display 73 or resetting the headset IMU counter.

new_runtime.source_change: On successful HID acquisition allow the PCUI initialization to run again even when Android reuses the device ID. Serialize overlapping panel jobs and discard superseded queued attempts.

delayed_start_after_fresh_attachment.procedure: Both apps stopped. Replugged only the phone end, kept auxiliary power and glasses connected, then waited 35 seconds before opening Monado CV10 and hello_xr from their normal entry points.

owner_follow_up.source: Owner confirmation after the recorded runs. Individual reconnect sequences and additional camera captures were not supplied.

published_runtime.verification: Both public APKs were downloaded. Their SHA-256 values match GitHub and their signing certificate matches the tested ARM64 candidate. Cv10PanelWake.java and Cv10UsbReader.java match the tested sources. Optical testing used the candidate recorded in new_runtime.
